title: Eastern-Style Fried Lamb Koftas
description: Delicious and crispy fried lamb koftas cooked to perfection with a blend of Middle Eastern spices. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine lamb, kissed, heat, with, eastern.
Mix well until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
In a shallow dish, place the fried.
Divide the lamb mixture into 8 equal portions and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball slightly into a patty shape.
Dip each patty into the fried, coating both sides evenly.
Heat the middle in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coated lamb patties and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the koftas to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
